english: Let $H$ be the hyperbola having one focus at $S(1,0)$, the corresponding directrix $3x+4y-15=0$, and passing through the point $P(3,0)$. Then the distance between the two directrices of $H$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $H$ वह अतिपरवलय है जिसकी एक नाभि $S(1,0)$ है, संगत नियता $3x+4y-15=0$ है, तथा जो बिन्दु $P(3,0)$ से होकर जाता है। तब $H$ की दोनों नियताओं के बीच की दूरी ______ है।
solution: $PS=2$, distance of $P$ from the directrix $=\dfrac{|9-15|}{5}=\dfrac65$, so $e=\dfrac{PS}{PM}=\dfrac53$
Distance of the focus from its directrix $p=\dfrac{|3-15|}{5}=\dfrac{12}{5}$
solution_full: By the focus-directrix definition, every point $X$ of $H$ satisfies $XS=e\cdot XM$, where $XM$ is the distance of $X$ from the directrix $3x+4y-15=0$ and $e>1$.
For $P(3,0)$: $PS=\sqrt{(3-1)^{2}+0^{2}}=2$ and $PM=\dfrac{|3\cdot3+4\cdot0-15|}{5}=\dfrac65$. Hence $e=\dfrac{2}{6/5}=\dfrac53$, which is greater than $1$, so the conic is indeed a hyperbola.
The distance of the focus $S$ from the corresponding directrix is $p=\dfrac{|3\cdot1+0-15|}{5}=\dfrac{12}{5}$.

The transverse axis is the line through $S$ perpendicular to the directrix. If $C$ is the centre and $Z$ the foot of the directrix on the axis, then $CS=ae$ and $CZ=\dfrac ae$, with $Z$ between $C$ and $S$. Hence $p=ae-\dfrac ae=a\cdot\dfrac{e^{2}-1}{e}$.
The two directrices are parallel lines at distance $\dfrac ae$ on either side of the centre, so the distance between them is $\dfrac{2a}{e}=2\cdot\dfrac94\cdot\dfrac35=\dfrac{27}{10}=2.7$.
Check: the vertices on the axis $(1+3t,\,4t)$ are $\left(\dfrac{19}{10},\dfrac65\right)$ and $\left(\dfrac{23}{5},\dfrac{24}{5}\right)$, whose distance is $\dfrac92=2a$.
originality_note: New: the hyperbola is fixed by a focus, an oblique directrix and one point on it, so e must first be read off from that point and then a is recovered from the focus-directrix gap p = a(e^2-1)/e before the directrix spacing 2a/e is obtained (way 5). Closest known: writing the equation of a conic from a given focus, directrix and eccentricity. Different because: e is not given, no equation is needed, and the answer comes from the chain e -> p -> a -> 2a/e along an oblique axis.

concept_use.hyperbola from the focus-directrix defin: The definition PS = e PM with the oblique directrix 3x+4y-15=0 gives e = 5/3 from the point P(3,0), and the focus-directrix gap p = 12/5 along the general axis.
concept_use.Basic elements of the standard hyperbola: The relations CS = ae, CZ = a/e give p = a(e^2-1)/e, hence a = 9/4, and the distance between the directrices 2a/e = 2.7.
